title: An affine open U is the image of an open immersion Spec Γ(U) -> X; points of U are primes of Γ(U)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U\subseteq X$ an affine open, i.e. an open subset such that the open subscheme $U$ is an affine scheme, and let $R=\mathcal O_X(U)$. There is a canonical open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] $\iota_U:\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] (the inverse of the isomorphism $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$ given by $U$ affine, followed by the inclusion $U\subseteq X$) whose image is $U$; for every $x\in U$ there is a prime $\mathfrak p_x\subset R$ (the image of $x$ under $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$) with $\iota_U(\mathfrak p_x)=x$.
